waves.name: Nightly Control-M cycle (JOBA then JOBB)
waves.rationale: Both jobs run only IEFBR14 and touch no dataset, so the family is batch-utility. They are chained by condition JOBA-DONE, so they move together as one wave. One wave is the right size: one sentence describes it, and splitting it would put the JOBA-DONE condition across a cutover boundary. The wave carries the whole must-not-break item, the nightly batch cycle, so its boundary is the scheduler ordering and not any data. Confidence is limited because the jobs do no visible work.
waves.unblocks: Nothing inside this tree. No program, copybook or dataset depends on it. It would prove the scheduler cutover path (condition handling, the external feed trigger) for any real work that is added later.
